system.description:
An operative on the outer ring of the Veiled Ones' intelligence network, which works for the Violet Conclave: trusted to collect, verify and pass on information, and told no more about the order above you than you need.

  • Silent Tail: Advantage on checks to observe, tail or surveil a target without being noticed. A creature you observed for at least 10 minutes before the fight has Disadvantage on its attacks against you in the first round.
    • 9th level: that creature also has Disadvantage on its saves against you in the first round.
  • Discreet Channels: Advantage on checks to collect, verify or pass on intelligence discreetly, and to give a plausible reason for being somewhere you shouldn't be.
